_comment: Curated source list — the starred sites, and what we are permitted to do with each.
This file is the source of truth, not sources.db. The database is gitignored and
rebuilt from data/, so a star stored only in SQLite would vanish on the next rebuild.
Starring in the admin writes back to this file; editing it in VS Code works too.
required  — always queried directly, not just when a search surfaces it
favorite  — preferred when it appears, ranked above unknown sites
normal    — met through search, no standing opinion
blocked   — never fetched, never stored (a written prohibition, or our own decision)
acquisition — how content from this site may legally reach our corpus:
fetch          — automated fetch is acceptable; no prohibition found
licensed       — we hold a licence or API agreement; terms recorded in `licence`
link-only      — store our own facts and link out; store no expression from the page
pending-review — starred but not yet legally reviewed; treated as `none` until it is

allrecipes.com.note: People Inc. robots.txt prohibits scraping except to direct traffic, and names TDM, LLM/RAG use and dataset creation as prohibited. Licensing contact: contentlicensing@people.inc

americastestkitchen.com.note: Owner-starred 2026-09-20. Subscription-gated: content behind a paid account means clickwrap terms and a contract layer that is independent of copyright. Review before any account is created for collection purposes.

seriouseats.com.note: Owner-starred 2026-09-20. Believed to be People Inc, the publisher family whose robots.txt prohibits dataset creation and RAG — needs its own robots.txt and terms checked directly before anything is fetched.

simplyrecipes.com.note: Identical People Inc. language to allrecipes.com.
